audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart is templated from a losing matchup: five of seven stages are marked Cassiopeia at 2/10, including Level 6 and First item, while Akali's own Emerald+ win rate here is 55.36%. The content whys already say Akali deletes her at 6 and on first item.
audit.why: Cassiopeia genuinely owns levels 1-2 (Noxious Blast on a 3.5s cooldown at 850 range, move speed on hit, against one Q and no shroud). Once Twilight Shroud is ranked, Twin Fang cannot select a target that spells and attacks cannot pick — a sustained-DPS mage loses to that outright, and level 6 plus first item are Akali's. The mirror audits/top/cassiopeia__akali.json reached the same chart from her side: L1-2 Cassiopeia, L3 Skill, L4-5/L6/first item Akali, two items Skill.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers on either side, and the Level 6 line was the generic template.
audit.why: Miasma is 24s at rank 1 falling to 16s — the longest cooldown in her kit and the one that denies Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution. Petrifying Gaze is 120s at rank 1 and only stuns enemies facing her, which is the one thing that cancels the R chain. Akali's spikes are Twilight Shroud ranked, level 6, and first AP item.
audit.corrected: Perfect Execution is two dashes, so you leap Miasma and finish her — but bait Petrifying Gaze (120s) first, the face-stun cancels you.

audit.whatIsWrong: Key Ability Interactions only restated that Miasma grounds. The decisive interaction of the lane — what Twilight Shroud does to Twin Fang — was never written.
audit.why: Riot's text: inside Twilight Shroud Akali is invisible and unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks. Twin Fang is a 0.75s single-target attack, so it has nothing to fire at while she is in the smoke; that is why a sustained-DPS mage loses the mid-lane stages. Miasma grounds, and grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities, so it is specifically the answer to Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution — hold both until it is spent (24s at rank 1).
audit.corrected: Miasma grounds you — it disables Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution. Inside Twilight Shroud her Twin Fang cannot select you at all.
